|lore=Queen Amidala posed as one of her own handmaidens for added safety as well as to keep an eye on her Jedi protectors. Was to be protected by the Jedi at all times.
|game_text=Adds 1 to power of anything she pilots. During opponent’s control phase, may use 2 Force to take one Leia or non-Jedi Luke into hand from Reserve Deck; reshuffle. At end of opponent’s turn, opponent loses 1 Force for each Skywalker occupying a battleground (-1 Force if Vader on table).

|notes=The [[Padmé Naberrie (V) (Virtual Set 11: Gathering Storm) (Original 2005)|2005 Gold Edition wording]] survives in the recovered publisher sheet. The Gold slip boosts each non-Jedi Skywalker’s defense value and destiny by 2 and searches for one twice per game. The remaster omits those bonuses and gives a paid search during the opponent’s control phase for Leia or non-Jedi Luke. Both retain the pilot bonus, end-of-turn Force loss and reduction if Vader is on table. Regular and alternate v17 art carry the same remaster text. [https://forum.starwarsccg.org/download/file.php?id=16604#page=1 Players Committee Gold Edition sheet, p. 1, slip 13]. [[:File:VS11O-13-Padme_Naberrie.png|Publisher slip]]. [https://res.starwarsccg.org/legacyblocks/VirtualCards11.pdf#page=2 Players Committee remastered sheet, p. 2, slip 13]. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20071024154617id_/http://www.swccgpc.com/Resources/VirtualCards11.pdf#page=2 Internet Archive]. [[:File:VS11O-13-Padme_Naberrie.png|Official slip]] records the same game text used by both preserved digital art renditions.
|sources=* [https://web.archive.org/web/20071024154617/http://www.swccgpc.com/Resources/VirtualCards11.pdf#page=2 VirtualCards11.pdf] (Players Committee Remaster sheet, Internet Archive 24 October 2007) — official text as of 4 December 2006 (errata to cards #8 and #27 on 25 June 2007); page 2, slip 13. Slip image and game text from this sheet.
